description: This file contains Bash shell functions and scripts for managing UBI volumes, reading firmware environment variables, and verifying root filesystem data on BCM4908 devices. It provides utility functions related to UBI metadata handling, environment setup, and filesystem verification specific to the device's firmware management.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian unsigned integer from a file at a specified offset using dd and hexdump.

methods.name: bcm4908_pkgtb_setup_env_config
methods.description: Sets up environment configuration by reading UBI volume size and creating a config file.

methods.name: bcm4908_committed_image_seq
methods.description: Retrieves the committed firmware image sequence number from environment metadata.

methods.name: bcm4908_verify_rootfs_data
methods.description: Verifies and maintains consistency of the root filesystem data UBI volume by mounting, checking, and possibly resetting the volume.
